description: Weston Homes was formed in 1987 by Bob Weston and is now one of the major property developers in the South East of England. Weston Homes has established a reputation for high quality design and build standards, delivered with a desire to make a genuine difference to the lives of our customers and to leave a legacy of which we are justly proud. Weston Homes combines the traditional skills of house-building with the ever-expanding opportunities created by new technology. British Offsite, one of Weston Group's subsidiary companies, has taken a revolutionary approach to property development. From the buildings’ structural and internal walls through to bathroom fittings, wardrobes and kitchen fittings, as much as possible is now pre-manufactured and tested in their own carefully controlled British Offsite factories, rather than on site. This drives up the environmental performance of the homes through reduced energy usage and wastage of materials during construction to greater energy efficiency for the homeowner, whilst maximising the quality of the finished properties. Weston Homes’ developments are hugely varied, ranging from select housing developments to large-scale city apartment complexes of many hundreds of homes. As well as new-build, the company has extensive experience of refurbishment and restoration work, breathing new life into historic and Listed buildings to give new purpose to Britain’s architectural heritage.
